boards.title: Your First Weekend at New Jersey Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that begins with campus orientation, leaves room for student resources, and ends with a nearby cultural visit.

cards.title: Start with a student-led campus tour
cards.subtitle: Fenster Hall • Friday or Saturday
cards.notes: Register for an official campus tour to get a walking introduction led by a Student Ambassador, then use the route to orient yourself for the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: An official walking introduction to NJIT.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s campus tours include a walking tour led by a Student Ambassador and an admissions information session.
cards.source_title: Campus Tour | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Registration and available tour dates are listed on NJIT’s official tour page.

cards.title: Use the Campus Center as your reset point
cards.subtitle: Campus Center • Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Stop in to locate a meal, a meeting space, games, or a film option; it is a practical central place to regroup after your first walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for meals, study, games, and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT identifies the Campus Center as the hub of cultural, educational, and social activities, with meals, meetings, study, films, games, and social activities.
cards.source_title: Campus Life and Student Services | NJIT Catalog
cards.access_notes: Campus access and individual services may vary; check NJIT postings when you arrive.

cards.title: Have a simple first campus meal
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, first floor • Friday evening
cards.notes: Find the Dining Hall on the Campus Center’s first floor and use the meal break to compare weekend plans with new classmates before heading to another activity.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining stop in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s official open-house agenda places the Dining Hall on the first floor of the Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Fall Open House Agenda | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Dining availability and payment options can change; confirm current service before going.

cards.entity_name: Joel and Diane Bloom Wellness and Events Center
cards.title: Check what is happening at the WEC
cards.subtitle: Bloom Wellness and Events Center • Friday night
cards.notes: Look for a public NJIT event or athletic program in the building, then confirm its entry details before making it your evening plan with friends.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose campus venue for events and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s Bloom Wellness and Events Center is a 220,000-square-foot multipurpose building; its venues include an arena, athletic field, practice courts, and theater.
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the specific event; verify the organizer’s current ticketing and attendance rules.

cards.title: Make the library your Saturday anchor
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue Building • Saturday morning
cards.notes: Walk through Van Houten to find a study base and the Information Commons; save the library hours page so you can plan later visits around its schedule.
cards.short_summary: NJIT’s main library and research space.
cards.evidence_claim: Van Houten Library is NJIT’s primary facility for researching, studying, and browsing physical and online resources and includes the Information Commons.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current hours page before visiting, including for holiday closures.

cards.title: See where prototypes take shape
cards.subtitle: NJIT Makerspace • Saturday midday
cards.notes: Visit during an authorized tour or access period to see the prototyping facility, and ask staff which training or booking steps apply before planning hands-on work.
cards.short_summary: A campus facility for prototyping and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT describes the Makerspace as a rapid-prototyping and collaboration facility with equipment for 3D printing, manufacturing, cutting, visualization, and simulation.
cards.source_title: Makerspace | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Equipment use and facility access may require authorization, training, or booking; verify with NJIT staff.

cards.title: Find the Learning Communities Lounge
cards.subtitle: Central King Building, room 205 • Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Drop by the Learning Communities Lounge to identify a first-year support point, meet a peer mentor if available, and ask what activities can help you get connected.
cards.short_summary: A first-year support lounge in Central King Building.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT’s Learning Communities page places its lounge in Central King Building room 205 and describes the program as supporting new students’ academic and social transition.
cards.source_title: Learning Communities | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: NJIT lists lounge hours as Monday–Thursday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm availability before a weekend visit.

cards.entity_name: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library
cards.title: Browse models and design materials at Littman
cards.subtitle: Weston Hall, fourth floor • Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Explore the architecture and design library’s materials, maps, drawings, and models, then note its location for a quieter return visit during the academic week.
cards.short_summary: A specialized architecture, art, and design library.
cards.evidence_claim: Littman Library is a university-library branch on the fourth floor of Weston Hall with architecture, art, and design resources in multiple formats.
cards.source_title: About Us | Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and access policies before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Writing Center before you need it
cards.subtitle: Central King Building, room G17 • Sunday planning stop
cards.notes: Find room G17 and save the Writing Center contact information now, so booking support for an early assignment is easier when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: NJIT’s writing-support location in Central King Building.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that the Writing Center is located in the Central King Building, Ground Floor, Room G17.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring sessions and appointments are managed by the Writing Center; consult its current scheduling information.

cards.title: Close with a Newark museum visit
cards.subtitle: 49 Washington Street • Sunday afternoon
cards.notes: Reserve a timed visit and bring your NJIT ID; Newark college students qualify for free museum admission, while planetarium programs are separately ticketed.
cards.short_summary: A nearby art museum with free general admission for Newark college students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Newark Museum of Art lists free general admission for students attending colleges and universities in Newark with valid ID, and requires advance reservations.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | The Newark Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists public hours Thursday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m., and asks all guests to reserve in advance.
